verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is the Live API, which the docs describe as real-time, low-latency voice and vision interaction with Gemini. That implies streamed output, but there is no explicit token-by-token text streaming documentation and no quantified latency behavior; the model card only admits 'occasional slowness or timeout issues.' missing for 10: explicit token-by-token streaming of text responses (e.g. a streaming generate endpoint or SDK method), documented latency figures (time-to-first-token or sub-second response claims), independent or hands-on latency corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream responses token by token (or get sub-second full answers) with the latency behavior documented

citations.quote: Live API を使用すると、Gemini と音声とビジョンによるやり取りを低レイテンシかつリアルタイムで行うことができます。
There may also be occasional slowness or timeout issues.
